ghost:
**Ghost** is a proactive AI assistant. You never prompt it. It watches the work
you're already doing, keeps track of the questions you left hanging, and tells you
when it sees something that answers one.

It speaks up only when it's confident and can show you what it saw. Everything else
waits in an inbox, and when there's nothing worth saying it stays quiet. It brings
you the finding and stops there. It never acts on your behalf.

All of it runs on your machine. Local Qwen model, local memory, nothing ever leaves
your disk. About 160k lines of C# so far.

projects.name: Signature Bay Homes
projects.blurb: Paste an address, get an underwriting scorecard. It models what a finished luxury home is worth on that lot, then works backwards to the most you can pay for the land and still clear your return. Comps, build cost, flood and insurance risk, and the evidence behind every number.

projects.name: Osteora
projects.blurb: An oral surgeon asked for something his colleagues would actually use. Doctors describe a case in plain language or upload a CBCT scan, and get back advice grounded in published literature, with the measurements read straight off the scan.

projects.name: TrackTwin
projects.blurb: Live race analytics for the Toyota GR Cup. Cars move on a real track map in real time while the models score braking balance, cornering and driver consistency, lap after lap.

projects.name: Turnaround
projects.blurb: Hands an airport's ground crew their day. Pairs every arrival to its departure, finds where the aircraft stack up, prices the staffing, and keeps an audit trail finance can argue with.

projects.name: MyMedicalNote
projects.blurb: Records a patient visit and writes the clinical note in SOAP, DAP or BIRP. The audio is deleted the moment it's transcribed, so there is no PHI sitting anywhere.

extras.name: Dominion
extras.blurb: Property due diligence in minutes instead of a week. Reads permits, zoning ordinances, council minutes, crime, demographics and parcel records across two Florida markets, then says buy, hold or pass with the evidence attached.

extras.name: AutoSchedule
extras.blurb: Claims nursing shifts on ShiftWizard the instant the pick window opens at 09:00. Logs in early, holds the session, fires within a fraction of a second, because the good nights go fast.

extras.name: MeetingQ
extras.blurb: A meeting overlay that reads your screen with OCR and answers what's on it. Invisible to screen shares and screenshots.

extras.name: Fraud detection
extras.blurb: Random Forest against Isolation Forest on 100k+ transactions. Move the sliders, watch precision and recall fight each other in real time.

extras.name: Anime Expeditions Macro
extras.blurb: Open-source auto-farm bot for a Roblox game. Computer vision for stage select, unit placement and win detection.

closing: Most of these repos are private. Ask me and I'll show you around.
